title: skills: data hooks and actions teach the multi-reason refusal throw (after #36877)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-ruled, the `Skills-docs:` term (5) of the ruling on #36877 (comment 7178348458; Bill, decision card 2026-11-26T00:01Z, 「A 一次抛多条原因逐行翻译」), filed by the owning zone under the parent. Source: maintainer.
Grading: area:ux · Feature · p2 · reach: every AI client writing an action or hook that refuses a selection · evidence: ruling text.

## What

After #36877, one throw can carry `{ code, reasons: [{ reason, params? }, …] }`; each reason renders translated, `userMessage` joins the lines, `details.refusals` carries them. The analysis 7178064820 §Execution 2(f) names the pages: `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`.
- Teach the list form beside the single `reason` form: every listed reason must be declared in the catalogue (an undeclared literal is refused at save, an undeclared reason at run is a 500 fault); both forms on one throw is a fault; the entry's own `message` closes the list.

## Acceptance

- Both pages show the list throw with a short example and the three rules above, matching the merged #36877 behaviour.
- Net added lines small (budget set at dispatch); governed surface, contract-tier build and review.

## Order

After the #36877 PR merges.

Blocked-by: #36877

Reader: zone o5-U (seat repo:objectstack#5) via a contract-tier card thread; the #36877 PR's `Skills-docs:` line points here.
